description: rekal deterministic memory: inject real recall on session start + each turn, auto-persist before compaction and at session end, and redirect file-based memory to rekal. Hooks run the released rekal from PyPI via uvx pinned to the version this plugin commit was released as — uvx caches the env after the first fetch, so nothing is ever built from the plugin copy and the warm path never resolves or touches the network. Bump the pin when tagging a release, after the PyPI publish.

hooks.prompt: Context is about to be compacted, so run the rekal-save procedure now before anything is lost: extract durable facts, decisions, and preferences from the transcript, dedupe each via mcp__rekal__memory_build_context then mcp__rekal__memory_store (pass replaces=<old_id> when a memory on the same topic exists; never two memories on one topic, never store secrets), and produce no user-facing output. Transcript: $ARGUMENTS

hooks.statusMessage: rekal: persisting memory at session end
